stories.title: Design Pick'ems Entries Table Schema
stories.goal: define a pickems_entries table that stores individual user picks for weekly matchups
stories.benefit: user pick'ems submissions are properly recorded with timestamps and lock enforcement
acceptanceCriteria: Pickems_entries table includes id (UUID, primary key), user_id (foreign key to users), matchup_id (foreign key to matchups), created_at, updated_at
Table stores predicted_winner_team_id (foreign key to teams) for user's pick
Schema includes locked_at timestamp to track when pick was finalized before lock time
Composite unique index on (user_id, matchup_id) ensures one pick per user per matchup
Foreign key constraints with ON DELETE CASCADE ensure cleanup when user or matchup is deleted

stories.title: Design Pick'ems Grading Results Table Schema
stories.goal: define a pickems_grading table that stores graded results for user picks after stat corrections
stories.benefit: pick accuracy is tracked with timestamps reflecting stat-correction-finalized grading
acceptanceCriteria: Pickems_grading table includes id (UUID, primary key), pickems_entry_id (foreign key to pickems_entries, unique)
Table stores is_correct boolean indicating if predicted winner matches actual matchup outcome
Schema includes graded_at timestamp reflecting when grading occurred post-stat-corrections
Table includes stat_correction_applied boolean flag to track if corrections impacted grading
Foreign key ensures grading records are deleted when parent pick entry is removed

stories.title: Design Weekly Pick'ems Stats Table Schema
stories.goal: define a pickems_weekly_stats table for aggregated user performance per week
stories.benefit: weekly stats queries execute efficiently without recalculating correct picks on every page load
acceptanceCriteria: Pickems_weekly_stats table includes id (UUID, primary key), user_id (foreign key to users), league_id (foreign key to leagues), season, week_number
Table stores correct_picks (integer), total_picks (integer), accuracy_percentage (decimal)
Schema includes weekly_rank (integer) calculated among all league participants for that week
Composite unique index on (user_id, league_id, season, week_number) ensures one stat record per user per week
Table includes graded_at timestamp reflecting when week's grading was finalized

stories.title: Design Season Pick'ems Stats Table Schema
stories.goal: define a pickems_season_stats table for aggregated user performance per season
stories.benefit: season-long performance tracking is efficient with pre-calculated cumulative statistics
acceptanceCriteria: Pickems_season_stats table includes id (UUID, primary key), user_id (foreign key to users), league_id (foreign key to leagues), season
Table stores cumulative correct_picks, total_picks, accuracy_percentage across all weeks
Schema includes season_rank (integer) based on correct picks with accuracy as tiebreaker
Table includes win_loss_record (JSON) storing correct-incorrect format (e.g., {wins: 45, losses: 23})
Composite unique index on (user_id, league_id, season) ensures one stat record per user per season

stories.title: Design All-Time Pick'ems Stats Table Schema
stories.goal: define a pickems_alltime_stats table for cumulative user performance across all seasons
stories.benefit: historical legacy tracking and all-time leaderboards are efficiently supported
acceptanceCriteria: Pickems_alltime_stats table includes id (UUID, primary key), user_id (foreign key to users), league_id (foreign key to leagues)
Table stores lifetime correct_picks, total_picks, overall_accuracy_percentage across all seasons
Schema includes alltime_rank (integer) based on cumulative correct picks
Table includes seasons_participated (integer) for tracking user engagement duration
Unique index on (user_id, league_id) ensures one all-time record per user per league

stories.title: Design Role-Based Leaderboards Schema
stories.goal: support separate Manager and Fan leaderboards through role-based stats filtering
stories.benefit: managers and fans can compete fairly within their respective role groups
acceptanceCriteria: Pickems_weekly_stats and pickems_season_stats include role (enum: 'manager', 'fan') derived from user membership
Queries can filter stats by role for separate Manager and Fan leaderboard generation
Schema includes role_rank fields: manager_rank and fan_rank calculated separately per role group
Role assignment updates propagate to stats tables when user role changes in league memberships
Indexes on (league_id, season, role, correct_picks DESC) optimize leaderboard queries

stories.title: Design Transactions Table Schema
stories.goal: define a transactions table that stores all fantasy league transactions from external platforms
stories.benefit: comprehensive transaction history is available for display, filtering, and engagement
acceptanceCriteria: Transactions table includes id (UUID, primary key), league_id (foreign key to leagues), transaction_type (enum), created_at, synced_at timestamps
Transaction_type enum includes: 'trade', 'waiver_claim', 'free_agent_add', 'free_agent_drop', 'draft_pick'
Table stores external_transaction_id (unique per league) for API sync deduplication
Schema includes involved_teams (JSON array) listing team_ids participating in transaction
Table includes transaction_details (JSONB) for flexible storage of players, picks, and platform-specific data

stories.title: Design Transaction Engagement Schema
stories.goal: track comments and reactions on transactions to support engagement-based promotion to newsfeed
stories.benefit: engaged transactions automatically surface to main feed without manual curation
acceptanceCriteria: Transactions table includes engagement_count (integer) aggregating comments and reactions
Table includes last_engagement_at timestamp for determining promotion eligibility
Schema includes promoted_to_feed boolean flag indicating if transaction was promoted to moments feed
Table includes promoted_at timestamp reflecting when promotion occurred
Comments and reactions use polymorphic relationship (reactable_type: 'transaction', reactable_id: transaction.id)

stories.title: Design League History Table Schema
stories.goal: define a league_history table for storing season summaries and historical records
stories.benefit: users can browse past seasons with champions, runner-ups, and season highlights
acceptanceCriteria: League_history table includes id (UUID, primary key), league_id (foreign key to leagues), season (unique per league)
Table stores champion_team_id (foreign key to teams), runner_up_team_id for final standings
Schema includes season_summary (text) for narrative description or commissioner notes
Table includes dynasty_continuity_data (JSONB) for linking seasons in dynasty leagues
Composite unique index on (league_id, season) ensures one history record per season

stories.title: Design Historical Week Links Schema
stories.goal: support deep linking to historical week views for power rankings, matchups, and picks
stories.benefit: users can navigate to any past week and see content as it appeared at that time
acceptanceCriteria: Schema supports queries filtering by league_id, season, and week_number across all tables
Power rankings, matchups, and pickems entries include season and week_number for historical access
URL routing supports pattern /[league-slug]/history/[season]/week/[week-number]
Historical data remains immutable after grading finalization to preserve accuracy
Indexes on (league_id, season, week_number) optimize historical week queries

stories.title: Implement Pick'ems Foreign Key Relationships
stories.goal: establish all foreign key constraints for pick'ems data integrity
stories.benefit: database maintains referential integrity and prevents orphaned pick records
acceptanceCriteria: Pickems_entries.user_id references users.id with ON DELETE CASCADE to remove picks when user deleted
Pickems_entries.matchup_id references matchups.id with ON DELETE CASCADE
Pickems_grading.pickems_entry_id references pickems_entries.id with ON DELETE CASCADE
Pickems_weekly_stats.user_id and pickems_season_stats.user_id reference users.id with ON DELETE CASCADE
All pick'ems tables include league_id foreign key referencing leagues.id with ON DELETE CASCADE

stories.title: Implement Transactions Foreign Key Relationships
stories.goal: establish all foreign key constraints for transactions data integrity
stories.benefit: database maintains referential integrity and prevents orphaned transaction records
acceptanceCriteria: Transactions.league_id references leagues.id with ON DELETE CASCADE
League_history.league_id references leagues.id with ON DELETE CASCADE
League_history.champion_team_id references teams.id with ON DELETE SET NULL to preserve history if team removed
Transaction engagement uses polymorphic relationships with proper foreign keys to transactions table
All involved_teams references in transaction_details JSONB are validated against existing team_ids

stories.title: Design Indexes for Pick'ems Query Optimization
stories.goal: create indexes on pick'ems tables for efficient leaderboard and stats queries
stories.benefit: leaderboards and personal stats pages load quickly even with large historical datasets
acceptanceCriteria: Index on pickems_entries(matchup_id, user_id) for fast pick lookups during grading
Index on pickems_weekly_stats(league_id, season, week_number, correct_picks DESC) for weekly leaderboards
Index on pickems_season_stats(league_id, season, role, correct_picks DESC) for role-based season leaderboards
Index on pickems_alltime_stats(league_id, correct_picks DESC) for all-time leaderboards
Composite index on pickems_entries(user_id, created_at DESC) for user pick history

stories.title: Design Indexes for Transactions Query Optimization
stories.goal: create indexes on transactions table for efficient filtering and sorting
stories.benefit: transaction pages with filters execute quickly with proper index support
acceptanceCriteria: Index on transactions(league_id, created_at DESC) for chronological transaction feed
Index on transactions(league_id, transaction_type) for type-based filtering
Index on transactions(league_id, engagement_count DESC, last_engagement_at DESC) for promoted feed eligibility
GIN index on transactions(involved_teams) for team-based transaction filtering (JSONB array queries)
Index on league_history(league_id, season) for historical season navigation

stories.title: Implement Database Triggers for Stats Updates
stories.goal: automate stats aggregation through database triggers when grading completes
stories.benefit: stats tables remain accurate without manual recalculation on every query
acceptanceCriteria: Trigger on pickems_grading INSERT/UPDATE recalculates pickems_weekly_stats for affected user and week
Trigger updates pickems_season_stats when weekly stats change
Trigger updates pickems_alltime_stats when season stats change
Trigger recalculates weekly_rank and season_rank when stats change for any user in league
Trigger on comments/reactions to transactions increments engagement_count and updates last_engagement_at

stories.title: Implement Row-Level Security for Pick'ems Data
stories.goal: configure Supabase RLS policies to enforce pick visibility rules at database level
stories.benefit: picks remain hidden from other users until lock time without application-level checks
acceptanceCriteria: Pickems_entries RLS policy allows users to read only their own picks before matchup lock time
After matchup lock time, RLS policy allows all league members to read all picks
Users can only INSERT/UPDATE their own picks and only before lock time
Pickems_grading, stats tables allow read access to all league members
RLS policies use Supabase auth.uid() and matchup lock timestamps for enforcement

stories.title: Implement Row-Level Security for Transactions Data
stories.goal: configure Supabase RLS policies for transactions data access control
stories.benefit: transactions data is secured appropriately based on league membership and visibility settings
acceptanceCriteria: Transactions table RLS policy allows read access to all league members
Transaction engagement (comments, reactions) follows same RLS rules as other content types
League_history table RLS policy allows read access based on league membership and visibility
Only admins can write to league_history for season summary management
RLS policies enforce league privacy settings for historical data access

stories.title: Support Stat Correction Regrading Schema
stories.goal: enable detection and handling of stat correction impacts on pick'ems grading
stories.benefit: grading remains accurate when official scores change after initial grading
acceptanceCriteria: Pickems_grading table includes previous_is_correct field for tracking grading changes
Schema includes regraded_at timestamp separate from initial graded_at
Table includes stat_correction_flag boolean indicating if this pick was affected by corrections
System maintains grading audit trail through timestamped updates
Stats tables update via triggers when regrading changes pick outcomes

stories.title: Design Transaction Filtering and Search Schema Support
stories.goal: enable efficient filtering of transactions by type, teams, date ranges, and search terms
stories.benefit: users can quickly find relevant transactions without scanning entire history
acceptanceCriteria: Transactions table supports filtering by transaction_type through indexed enum column
JSONB involved_teams field supports array containment queries for team-based filtering
Transaction_details JSONB field supports full-text search for player names
Created_at timestamp supports date range queries with proper indexing
Schema supports pagination with efficient LIMIT/OFFSET queries on indexed columns

stories.title: Support Dynasty League Continuity in Historical Data
stories.goal: maintain proper linking of teams and stats across seasons in dynasty leagues
stories.benefit: dynasty league members see continuous history while redraft leagues show season breaks
acceptanceCriteria: Teams table stable_fantasy_user_id field links team continuity across seasons
League_history dynasty_continuity_data JSONB maps teams across season transitions
Pick'ems stats properly aggregate across all seasons for dynasty leagues using stable IDs
Historical queries respect dynasty vs redraft league type for proper season grouping
Schema supports team ownership changes within dynasty continuity tracking
